logp.method_description: The shake flask method [12] was used to predict the lipophilicity of the complexes. Solid complexes were placed into a vial and partitioned between 10 mL of 1-octanol and 10 mL of a buffered aqueous solution at pH 7.4. The flask was agitated for 24 h and the complex in each phase is quantified by UV–Vis spectroscopy. The partition coefficients of quinolone 3 and ciprofloxacin-based complexes could not be measured, since they are sparingly soluble in 1-octanol and water.
